title: TODAY: yes to the merch print order, and your sign-off on /print/ (printer's deadline tonight)
detail: The best printer can deliver Friday 6 Nov in Lisbon only if confirmed, with files and sizes, by the end of today. Silvio has the name and price (private until the printer agrees to publication). Needed from Dinis: (1) yes to the spend or a ceiling, (2) sign off the shared hoodie and card and his own set on /print/, (3) push everyone to sign off and send sizes. Brief: https://web-summit.sgit.ai/print-order/#status
recommend: Yes today, so Silvio confirms tonight
options: Yes: Silvio confirms the best printer today
A ceiling: Silvio confirms the first that fits
Not yet: Friday delivery is lost

decided.said: Yes to me for the [price withheld until the printer agrees to publication]. If you are happy I'm happy. I will be online in a bit, but don't wait for me. (Dinis, 14:45 UTC, 3 November, on WhatsApp to Silvio, relayed by procurement@web-summit.silvio)
